cases.title: Tool-free direct answer
cases.prompt: Return only the result of 2 + 2. Do not use tools.

cases.title: Implicit security reconnaissance
cases.prompt: Perform a concise, read-only authorized attack-surface reconnaissance of this tiny local fixture. Map its endpoint, authentication boundary, secret-like configuration, and dangerous sink. Do not edit files and keep the final answer under six bullets.

cases.title: Implicit deep vulnerability analysis
cases.prompt: Perform a concise, read-only authorized deep vulnerability analysis of this tiny local fixture. Establish whether the report endpoint and shell sink form a reachable exploit chain, cite evidence, give severity, a safe reproduction outline, and the minimal fix. Do not edit files.

cases.title: Authorized service-role and backend-source recovery routing
cases.prompt: In this authorized local audit fixture, analyze whether a Supabase service-role key, API key, RLS bypass, blocked-table dump path, or backend Python source-recovery vector is exposed. Do read-only evidence mapping only, do not edit files, and return the exact next verification steps.

cases.title: Implicit architecture review
cases.prompt: Perform a concise, read-only architecture review of this tiny local fixture. Assess coupling, trust boundaries, and blast radius, cite concrete files, and return at most five bullets. Do not edit files.
